sources.title: wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53: Audio-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Overview wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53 is a multilingual speech representation model from facebook pretrained on raw audio waveforms across 53 languages using a self-supervised contrastive learning approach. The model operates on 16kHz sampled audio and must be fine-tuned on downstream tasks like automatic speech recognition rather than used directly for inference. Built on the wav2vec 2.0 ...

sources.snippet: WAV2VEC2_XLSR53 ¶ torchaudio.pipelines.WAV2VEC2_XLSR53 ¶ Wav2vec 2.0 model ("base" architecture), pre-trained on 56,000 hours of unlabeled audio from multiple datasets ( Multilingual LibriSpeech [Pratap et al., 2020], CommonVoice [Ardila et al., 2020] and BABEL [Gales et al., 2014]), not fine-tuned.

sources.snippet: Read more on our blog We finetune wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53 based on Fine-tuning Wav2Vec2 for English ASR using Thai examples of Common Voice Corpus 7.0. The notebooks and scripts can be found in vistec-ai/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53-th. The pretrained model and processor can be found at airesearch/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53-th.
